notes.1: Many candidates appreciated that sensitivity is a characteristic of all living things. A few incorrectly opted for breathing, indicating confusion between respiration and breathing.
notes.2: The meaning of the term species was not widely understood.
notes.3: This proved to be a challenging question. The number of candidates selecting each option suggests that many candidates were unsure that having two pairs of legs on each segment is a feature of some myriapods. Cambridge International General Certificate of Secondary Education 0610 Biology June 2021
notes.8: This question was well answered by many candidates. Some candidates incorrectly believed that the potato cylinder would become shorter and firmer.
notes.11: Many candidates appreciated that during an enzyme-controlled reaction the substrate changes into products. Some candidates incorrectly believed that the enzyme is gradually used up during the reaction.
notes.12: This proved to be a demanding question. Only areas of the leaf that possess chlorophyll would have starch and turn blue-black. The white areas of the leaf would be the same colour as the iodine which is yellow- brown.
notes.18: The effect of temperature and humidity on the movement of dye up a plant stem was not well understood by many candidates, perhaps missing the link to transpiration.
notes.19: Most candidates did not appreciate that blood enters the heart through veins into the atria.
notes.20: Few candidates correctly identified the blood vessel as an artery, often confusing it with a vein.
notes.23: Many candidates appreciated that muscle contraction, protein synthesis and the maintenance of a constant body temperature all require energy.
notes.24: There was some uncertainty over the products of anaerobic respiration in yeast. The products are alcohol and carbon dioxide.
notes.26: Many candidates did not appreciate that the effector in the reflex arc was the muscle.
notes.27: Many candidates did not appreciate that if a person’s iris is damaged the person cannot control how much light enters the eye.
notes.30: Many candidates correctly identified X as the urethra, although some candidates incorrectly believed it to be the sperm duct.
notes.31: Few candidates realised that the egg is released when the lining of the uterus is thickest. Cambridge International General Certificate of Secondary Education 0610 Biology June 2021
